mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and GDPC1 decline, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 monthly growth indicates a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 signals a manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 90, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a sharp drop in consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 600,000 units signals weak residential construction, which typically precedes broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 600, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.
